name: SmartIcon
description: Advanced state machine that morphs SVGs based on semantic context.
code:
import { SmartIcon } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(SmartIcon({ icons: { ... } }));

options.name: icons
options.description: Map of state names to SVG strings.

options.name: defaultState
options.description: Initial semantic state used before any hover interaction resolves.

options.name: useSemanticTags
options.description: Resolve smart states from semantic HTML tags such as links and buttons.

options.name: transitionDuration
options.description: Morph transition time in ms.

options.name: switchDelay
options.description: Minimum ms a state must be requested before committing to the next icon.

options.name: size
options.description: Size of the icon container.

options.name: color
options.description: Color applied to the icon container. SVGs that use `currentColor` will inherit it. If empty, the icon keeps its original fill.

options.name: offset
options.description: Fixed offset from the pointer position.

options.name: anchor
options.description: Alignment (center, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right).

options.name: followStrategy
options.description: Whether the icon smoothly follows the pointer or snaps to it.

options.name: rotateWithVelocity
options.description: Rotate the icon based on movement velocity.

name: SmartRing
description: A reactive ring that distorts with velocity and adapts to stuck elements.
code:
import { SmartRing } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(SmartRing({ size: 24, color: '#f59e0b', enableSkew: true }));

options.name: size
options.description: Base diameter.

options.name: hoverSize
options.description: Diameter when hovering interactive elements.

options.name: color
options.description: Border color.

options.name: fill
options.description: Background fill color.

options.name: borderWidth
options.description: Border thickness in pixels.

options.name: mixBlendMode
options.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the ring element.

options.name: enableSkew
options.description: Distort the ring based on velocity (stretch and rotate).

name: Sparkles
description: Emits particle trails based on movement velocity.
code:
import { Sparkles } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Sparkles({ color: '#f59e0b', frequency: 10 }));

options.name: color
options.description: Particle color.

options.name: count
options.description: Number of particles in the pool.

options.name: frequency
options.description: Pixels of movement required to spawn a particle. Lower values for a denser trail.

options.name: decay
options.description: Fade rate (0-1 per second). Higher values make for faster fading.

options.name: scatter
options.description: Random position offset for particle spawning.

name: TextRing
description: Rotates text around the cursor position.
code:
import { TextRing } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(TextRing({ text: 'LOADING • ', radius: 40 }));

options.name: text
options.description: Text content.

options.name: radius
options.description: Ring radius in pixels.

options.name: fontSize
options.description: Text size in pixels.

options.name: speed
options.description: Rotation speed in degrees per second.

options.name: color
options.description: Text color.

options.name: opacity
options.description: Opacity of the rendered ring container.

options.name: className
options.description: Optional CSS class added to the container.

options.name: spread
options.description: Stretch the text to fit the entire circle using cross-browser letter-spacing.

name: Glitch
description: Chromatic separation and torn slices, drawn behind an SVG displacement map.
code:
import { Glitch } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Glitch({ size: 18, intensity: 6, chaos: 0.35 }));

options.name: size
options.description: Diameter of the cursor in pixels.

options.name: color
options.description: Core colour. The ghosts sit either side of it.

options.name: red
options.description: Colour of the negative-offset ghost.

options.name: cyan
options.description: Colour of the positive-offset ghost.

options.name: intensity
options.description: Maximum ghost separation in pixels, and the displacement scale.

options.name: chaos
options.description: 0-1. The tear rate. Higher means a slice is torn out and shifted more often.

options.name: hoverBoost
options.description: Scale the effect up while hovering a registered target.

options.name: blend
options.description: Compositing mode for the whole cursor.

name: MotionBlur
description: A camera-shutter blur: the head smears along its own direction of travel.
code:
import { MotionBlur } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(MotionBlur({ size: 12, intensity: 0.55 }));

options.name: size
options.description: Diameter of the head in pixels.

options.name: color
options.description: Head colour.

options.name: intensity
options.description: Pixels of blur at 1000px/s of travel.

options.name: maxSpread
options.description: Ceiling for the blur, so a fast flick does not shred the cursor.

options.name: stretch
options.description: Squash and widen the head along the motion axis.

options.name: blend
options.description: Compositing mode for the whole cursor.

name: Comet
description: A gradient tail whose length is the pointer's speed.
code:
import { Comet } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Comet({ size: 10, length: 9, color: '#f59e0b' }));

options.name: size
options.description: Diameter of the head in pixels.

options.name: length
options.description: Tail length in pixels at 1000px/s of travel.

options.name: maxLength
options.description: Hard ceiling for the tail, in pixels.

options.name: color
options.description: Colour of the head, and the opaque end of the tail gradient.

options.name: blur
options.description: Softens the tail into light rather than a hard shape.

options.name: blend
options.description: Compositing mode for the whole cursor.

name: Inkblot
description: A press leaves a mark that spreads and dries, warped by a turbulence map.
code:
import { Inkblot } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Inkblot({ size: 46, color: '#f59e0b' }));

options.name: size
options.description: Radius of a blot at the moment of contact.

options.name: count
options.description: Number of blots that can be in flight at once.

options.name: duration
options.description: Milliseconds a blot takes to spread and dry.

options.name: spacing
options.description: Pixels of travel between droplets while the button is held.

options.name: color
options.description: Ink colour.

options.name: organic
options.description: Wobble the blot's edge with a turbulence displacement map.

name: Ripple
description: Concentric rings that carry outward from the press point and thin as they go.
code:
import { Ripple } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Ripple({ size: 96, thickness: 2 }));

options.name: size
options.description: Radius a ring reaches before it dies.

options.name: count
options.description: Rings that can be alive at once.

options.name: duration
options.description: Milliseconds for one ring to expand out.

options.name: thickness
options.description: Stroke weight at birth, in pixels.

options.name: color
options.description: Ring colour.

options.name: hold
options.description: Keep emitting rings while the button stays down.

options.name: interval
options.description: Milliseconds between rings while held.

options.name: spacing
options.description: Pixels of travel between rings while dragging.

options.name: blend
options.description: Compositing mode for the whole cursor.

name: Lens
description: A disc of glass held over the page: the backdrop is blurred, brightened and oversaturated behind a bright rim.
code:
import { Lens } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Lens({ size: 64, hoverSize: 108, blur: 5 }));

options.name: size
options.description: Diameter at rest.

options.name: hoverSize
options.description: Diameter while hovering a registered target.

options.name: blur
options.description: Backdrop blur radius, in pixels.

options.name: saturation
options.description: Backdrop saturation multiplier.

options.name: brightness
options.description: Backdrop brightness multiplier.

options.name: tint
options.description: Glass tint laid over the backdrop. A solid value hides the blur.

options.name: rim
options.description: Colour of the rim highlight.

options.name: press
options.description: Scale the lens down while pressed.

options.name: zIndex
options.description: Stacking order inside the cursor stage.

name: Halftone
description: A printed dot screen built from one tiled CSS radial gradient, loading up with ink as it accelerates.
code:
import { Halftone } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Halftone({ size: 132, cell: 9, dot: 0.32 }));

options.name: size
options.description: Diameter of the disc.

options.name: cell
options.description: Grid pitch at rest, in pixels.

options.name: dot
options.description: Dot radius as a fraction of the cell.

options.name: color
options.description: Ink colour.

options.name: react
options.description: Tighten the grid and fatten the dots as the pointer speeds up.

options.name: mask
options.description: Fade the grid out at the rim instead of ending it on a hard edge.

name: Spotlight
description: A reveal disc inside any matched container, trailing the pointer on its own easing.
code:
import { Spotlight } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Spotlight({ selector: '[data-spotlight]', maxRadius: 190 }));

options.name: selector
options.description: Containers that get a reveal disc. Rescanned on an interval.

options.name: maxRadius
options.description: Radius the disc opens to while the pointer is inside a container.

options.name: expandRate
options.description: Easing rate for the disc's radius.

options.name: lagRate
options.description: Easing rate for the disc's trailing position.

options.name: color
options.description: Colour of the disc. White with `difference` reads as a cut-out.

options.name: blendMode
options.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the disc.

options.name: rescan
options.description: Milliseconds between container rescans.

options.name: zIndex
options.description: Stacking order inside the matched container.

name: Scanner
description: A beam spanning the viewport, trailing the pointer with a lead in the direction of travel.
code:
import { Scanner } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Scanner({ orientation: 'vertical', color: '#00e5ff', lead: 1.1 }));

options.name: orientation
options.description: Which axes get a beam.

options.name: thickness
options.description: Width of each line in pixels.

options.name: glow
options.description: Width of the soft halo either side of a line.

options.name: glowOpacity
options.description: Halo strength, 0-1.

options.name: color
options.description: Beam colour.

options.name: lead
options.description: Lead in pixels at 1000px/s of pointer speed.

options.name: maxLead
options.description: Ceiling for the lead, in pixels.

options.name: hoverBoost
options.description: Sharpen the core glow while hovering a registered target.

name: Calligraphy
description: A wet nib dragging a simulated spring chain, swelling where the pointer slows down.
code:
import { Calligraphy } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Calligraphy({ points: 44, width: 7, color: '#f59e0b' }));

options.name: points
options.description: Links in the spring chain. More links, longer ribbon.

options.name: width
options.description: Stroke width at the nib, in pixels. The chain tapers from here.

options.name: spring
options.description: Spring stiffness of each link. Higher is a stiffer, shorter ribbon.

options.name: friction
options.description: Velocity retained per frame. Lower is more drag.

options.name: color
options.description: Ink colour.

options.name: idle
options.description: Draw a dormant signature before the pointer has ever moved.

options.name: idleRate
options.description: Rate of the dormant signature.

options.name: blend
options.description: Compositing mode for the canvas.

name: Pixel
description: An 8x8 bitmap cursor, scaled with hard edges and optionally snapped to a grid.
code:
import { Pixel } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Pixel({ sprite: 'arrow', cell: 8, snap: 0 }));

options.name: sprite
options.description: Which sprite from the built-in set to draw.

options.name: cell
options.description: Pixels per sprite pixel, rounded to a whole number. Only the style box changes.

options.name: snap
options.description: Grid pitch the position snaps to. `0` leaves the cursor free.

options.name: primary
options.description: Colour of the sprite's filled pixels.

options.name: secondary
options.description: Colour of the sprite's detail slot.

options.name: flip
options.description: Turn to face the direction of travel.

options.name: blend
options.description: Compositing mode for the sprite.

options.name: zIndex
options.description: Stacking order inside the cursor stage.

name: ASCII
description: Stamps characters along the path and evaporates them with a destination-out wipe.
code:
import { ASCII } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(ASCII({ charset: '0123456789', size: 14, fade: 1.6 }));

options.name: charset
options.description: Characters to draw from, walked in order.

options.name: size
options.description: Font size in pixels.

options.name: spacing
options.description: Pixels of travel between stamps.

options.name: color
options.description: Ink colour.

options.name: fade
options.description: How fast the ink evaporates, in alpha per second.

options.name: spread
options.description: Random position scatter, in pixels.

options.name: tilt
options.description: Maximum random rotation of a glyph, in degrees.

options.name: react
options.description: Widen the spacing with speed, so a fast pass reads as data, not prose.

options.name: blend
options.description: Compositing mode for the canvas.

name: Grain
description: Film grain from an feTurbulence field, tinted through a colour matrix and clipped to a disc.
code:
import { Grain } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Grain({ size: 96, grain: 0.75, density: 0.55 }));

options.name: size
options.description: Diameter of the disc.

options.name: grain
options.description: Noise frequency. Higher is finer grain.

options.name: density
options.description: Threshold on the noise field, 0-1: how much survives as visible speckle.

options.name: color
options.description: Palette: the grain is painted in this colour.

options.name: flicker
options.description: New noise fields per second. `0` freezes the grain.

options.name: react
options.description: Fatten the grain while the pointer is moving.

options.name: blend
options.description: Compositing mode for the disc.

options.name: zIndex
options.description: Stacking order inside the cursor stage.

name: Reflection
description: A likeness of the cursor, mirrored about the viewport axis and flipped so it reads as one.
code:
import { Reflection } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Reflection({ axis: 'x', size: 10, opacity: 0.55 }));

options.name: axis
options.description: Which axis to mirror across. `both` adds the corner reflection.

options.name: size
options.description: Diameter of the reflection.

options.name: color
options.description: Colour of the reflection.

options.name: opacity
options.description: Opacity of the reflection.

options.name: lines
options.description: Draw the mirror axis as a hairline.

options.name: blur
options.description: Blur on the reflection, to separate it from the real cursor.

options.name: blend
options.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the reflection.

options.name: zIndex
options.description: Stacking order inside the cursor stage.

name: Blob
description: A gelatinous body whose outline is a ring of springs: it stretches into travel and rings when it is struck.
code:
import { Blob } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Blob({ size: 64, squash: 0.7, spring: 0.22 }));

options.name: size
options.description: Diameter at rest, in pixels.

options.name: color
options.description: Body fill.

options.name: rim
options.description: Outline stroke. `transparent` leaves a bare silhouette.

options.name: points
options.description: Points around the outline, 6-32. Fewer is lumpier, more is rounder.

options.name: squash
options.description: How far travel pulls the leading edge out, 0-1.

options.name: wobble
options.description: Depth of the idle breathing, 0-1. Ignored when `prefers-reduced-motion` is set.

options.name: spring
options.description: How hard the outline is pulled back to its rest radius.

options.name: drag
options.description: Radius kept per 60Hz frame. Low keeps ringing after a press.

options.name: hoverSize
options.description: Diameter while hovering a registered target.

options.name: blend
options.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the whole cursor.

name: Spring
description: Smoothing as a second-order system: a frequency to travel at and a damping ratio to settle by.
code:
import { Spring } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Spring({ size: 16, frequency: 3.2, damping: 0.75 }));

options.name: size
options.description: Diameter of the body at rest.

options.name: color
options.description: Body colour, and the colour of the pointer hairline.

options.name: frequency
options.description: Undamped natural frequency in hertz: how fast the body wants to arrive.

options.name: damping
options.description: Damping ratio. 1 settles without overshooting; below 1 bounces, above 1 creeps.

options.name: squash
options.description: How far the body stretches along the momentum it is carrying.

options.name: hoverSize
options.description: Diameter while hovering a registered target.

options.name: showTarget
options.description: Draw the raw pointer as a hairline, so the lag can be seen.

options.name: blend
options.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the whole cursor.

name: Pendulum
description: A bob on a rigid rod, hinged at the pointer, integrated with Verlet so the rod is a constraint rather than a spring.
code:
import { Pendulum } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Pendulum({ rod: 96, bob: 14, gravity: 2600 }));

options.name: rod
options.description: Rod length in pixels, 20-160.

options.name: bob
options.description: Bob diameter in pixels.

options.name: color
options.description: Colour of the rod, hinge and bob.

options.name: gravity
options.description: Downward acceleration, in pixels per second squared.

options.name: drag
options.description: Kinetic energy kept per 60Hz frame. Near 1 swings for a long time.

options.name: entrance
options.description: How far off the vertical the bob is released the first time the cursor appears.

options.name: hoverSize
options.description: Bob diameter while hovering a registered target.

options.name: blend
options.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the whole cursor.

name: Vortex
description: A field of motes orbiting the cursor, wound up by the direction of travel and unwound when it reverses.
code:
import { Vortex } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Vortex({ count: 26, radius: 34, gain: 9 }));

options.name: count
options.description: Motes in the field, 6-48. Set at construction.

options.name: size
options.description: Mote diameter in pixels.

options.name: radius
options.description: Orbit radius in pixels.

options.name: spin
options.description: Idle angular velocity in degrees per second. Zero means the field only turns when it is moved.

options.name: gain
options.description: Degrees per second of spin added per pixel per second of pointer speed.

options.name: color
options.description: Mote and eye colour.

options.name: jitter
options.description: Spread off a perfect circle, and how much the ring breathes.

options.name: core
options.description: Diameter of the glowing eye at the centre. Zero hides it.

options.name: blend
options.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the field.

name: Fluid
description: A stable-fluids simulation on a coarse grid: the pointer pushes a projected velocity field and the dye is advected by it.
code:
import { Fluid } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Fluid({ resolution: 96, force: 1.1, fade: 0.55 }));

options.name: resolution
options.description: Simulation width in cells, quantised to 8. The height follows the stage aspect.

options.name: color
options.description: Dye colour.

options.name: force
options.description: Multiplier on the injected force. 1 travels exactly as fast as the hand.

options.name: swirl
options.description: Rotational share of the push, so the dye curls as it leaves the pointer.

options.name: fade
options.description: Dye lost per second.

options.name: drag
options.description: Velocity lost per second: how quickly the flow dies when the pointer stops.

options.name: iterations
options.description: Jacobi iterations of the pressure projection. Zero leaves the flow compressing into itself.

options.name: ink
options.description: Dye laid down per 60Hz frame at the pointer.

options.name: blend
options.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the canvas.
